content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, Thank you for sending over the agreement. I am looking forward to working together, but I would like to request a couple of small adjustments before I sign. Specifically: - Regarding the clause stating 'The parties intend to allow 15 rounds of ordinary revisions for the principal creative Deliverables. Additional revisions may require a written change order.', allowing 15 rounds is unusually high and could lead to endless modifications; I propose changing this to allow up to 2 rounds, with additional revisions requiring a written change order and separate fees. - Regarding the clause stating 'Invoices are payable Net 60.', waiting two months for payment creates cash flow challenges; I propose updating the terms to Net 30. Please let me know if these adjustments work for you so I can sign and return the document. Best regards,
